Messages.Author: Jeff Dai
Messages.Body:
Hello:

I was recently playing around with a Followers of Set deck and I noticed
something bizzare.

Is the Summon the Serpent card supposed to be a serpentis card? It seems
to have a bold text that suggests it should be a discipline cartd rather
than a clan card.

Summon the Serpent
Action
Follower of Set required
2 blood
Text: Serach your crypt for a vampire with the Serpentis Discipline. Show
it to all players and place it face down in your inactive region.
Reshuffle your crypt afterwards.
IN BOLD: As above, and move one blood from the blood bank to the inactive
vampire.

I'm guessing this is just a printing error that was missed. But if it
isn't what constitutes a mastered vampire?

Tom? Any thoughts?

Jeff

Messages.Author: Robert Piechocki
Messages.Body:


There has been an official WOTC errata for this and Purity of the Beast
neither should have a superior form, period.

Morninglord Calamar Kateri
